ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
The withdrawal petition, board resolution, complete university certificate, Tolstoy's later recollection, explanatory notes, Simonov biography, and all three page markers are represented.
своекоштного is rendered maintained at his own expense, preserving the historical administrative sense rather than using a modern tuition category.
The awkward official certificate syntax is kept relatively formal rather than rewritten as modern bureaucratic prose; отлично-хорошего is retained as excellently good.
Tolstoy's titles Наказ and Esprit des lois remain distinct; the editors' bracketed gloss Дух законов is translated as The Spirit of the Laws.
